title: Aliases and back-links for gitlab/commit-signing-and-provenance (GPG, PGP, OpenPGP)
goal: _tools/aliases.csv holds the rows 'pgp,gpg', 'openpgp,gpg' and 'gpg,gpg', and the Reference sections of kb/public/gitlab/protected-branches-tags.md, kb/public/gitlab/mr-approvals.md and kb/public/security/supply-chain.md name gitlab/commit-signing-and-provenance.md

run: import csv,pathlib,sys; r={tuple(x) for x in csv.reader(open('_tools/aliases.csv',encoding='utf-8'))}; w={('pgp','gpg'),('openpgp','gpg'),('gpg','gpg')}; l=all('gitlab/commit-signing-and-provenance.md' in pathlib.Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in ('kb/public/gitlab/protected-branches-tags.md','kb/public/gitlab/mr-approvals.md','kb/public/security/supply-chain.md')); sys.exit(0 if w<=r and l else 1)
